## Install and update

New here? Download **RustyMCLA.exe**, put it in a folder of its own and start it; it walks you through the setup. You need your own disc image of the Xbox 360 version of the game (*Midnight Club: Los Angeles, Complete Edition*). Nothing of the game is included.

Already installed? The launcher offers this update by itself. You can always skip it.

The launcher is not code-signed, so Windows may show "Windows protected your PC". Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, after comparing the SHA-256 below with your download.
